protocol.rule: Use two fresh first attempts per route through the repaired worker on clones of the same catalog. Grade supported useful output, verified offers on answerable requests and material evidence errors. Keep Sol low unless the challenger demonstrates better buyer outcomes. Timing and cost are secondary. Counterbalance order by request. Keep these cases separate from both evaluations.
protocol.checked_inputs: The reference collector and its SQLite database are outside the buyer worker. No reference prices, links or seller names enter the request.

scope: Model selection, not the eight-case milestone. Each attempt used an isolated database cloned from the independent catalog handoff, with 24 directory entries, two corpus resources, ten observations and zero offer-table rows. The evaluator database and reference URLs stayed outside the buyer requests.
